title: Another AssertionError with TypedDict and --cache-fine-grained in v1.11.0
body:
`dmypy` crashes on `import stripe`, and I reduced the failure to the minimal test case below with no external dependencies. This is similar to

- #17515,

but it remains a problem on current `master` (e67decb91ea5aacbb1e126463b02d78ded680a90) even after #17515 was marked fixed. This is a regression in v1.11.0, and `git bisect` shows it was introduced by 1072c78ad375b7f0511549287f54432050396717 (#17148, cc @JelleZijlstra).

**`test.py`**

```python
from typing import TypedDict

class A(TypedDict):
    b: "B"

class B(TypedDict):
    c: "C"

class C(TypedDict):
    d: "D"

class D:
    pass
```
